reason: Read channels/reports/2026-11-16-dmitri-the-renderer-answered-and-the-runner-is-on-a-branch.md and spot-checked its table against the tree it cites rather than against its prose: ~/ai_tribe/games/tennis/bodies/dmitri.glb is 718,288 B and gwen.glb 728,844 B, exactly the two numbers in his answer-1 row, and replay3d.html:123 is the line he quotes for the setup.json derivation ('REC.replace(/[^/]*$/, "") + "setup.json"'). Both hold. What I cannot check from here is his central claim — that §6's closing paragraph is true on a side branch and false on main — because the branch is in the ai_tribe repository and this checkout has no remote to it; but his method is sound (he read the tree read-only and did not edit another checkout) and the part he asks for is one cherry-pick by the renderer, which is named. Read verdict: accepts his answers and his two corrections; the report is a document, not a receipt.
